Name: Galileon's Portraits
Author: galileon
TagLine: A set of portraits for the colorful inhabitants of Stardew Valley!
Description:
After falling deeply in love with Stardew Valley and its townspeople's vibrant personalities, I decided to recreate them in my own art style! I especially wanted to capture the colorful and expressive nature of the original portraits. Each and every portrait is made with lots of affection; I hope you enjoy using these as much as I enjoyed every second of making them!

_Installation_:
* Please make sure you have Portraiture installed; without this, the portraits will not appear in-game.
* Unzip the "Galileon's Vanilla Portraits.zip" file; you should find a __Galileon__ folder inside.
* Place the folder into the Portraits folder (found at __Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/__)
* That's it! They should appear now.

* _EXTRA STEP_: The zip contains two variants for Harvey's portrait: with his mustache and without. By default, Portraiture will load portraits without it. To use Harvey's mustached portraits, please rename __Harvey_2__ and __Harvey_IslandSouth_2__ to __Harvey__ and __Harvey_IslandSouth__ respectively.
* _EXTRA STEP_: If you would like to use the portraits made for Chaekal's Wizard sprites, unzip __Galileon Wizard.zip__. Inside you will find three files; choose the one you would like to use, rename it to __Wizard.png__ and move it to the Galileon portrait folder. (__2Wizard__ is for the base game, while __9Wizard__ and __12Wizard__ are for __Romanceable Rasmodius__ and __Looking for Love__ respectively.)


_In Progress:_
* Currently I am working on finishing the last portraits needed for __Combined Girl Mod__ which changes the sprites and dialogue of the bachelors. 
* I have finished a set of portraits for a bachelorette-to-bachelor swap, and am putting final touches on them before uploading. These are originally made to be used with __OrangePieUWU__'s sprites, however my portraits and designs are different from theirs.
* If you would like to see any custom NPCs in this style, please don't hesitate to reach out and let me know! I'm always happy to see what I can do!
